hero_desc: The token that turns every click into global impact. Powered by the collective force of its holders, World Click (WMT) is a decentralized utility token born from the vision of an ecosystem where global competition, philanthropy, and the digital economy converge in a single click.
hero_tagline: Play. Compete. Win. Every click changes the world. 🌍
about_desc: World Click (WMT) is more than a token — it's a movement. A decentralized ecosystem where global competition, philanthropy, and the digital economy converge in a single click. Every interaction adds points, every season crowns a nation, every game changes something real in the world.
f1_desc: Every click adds points to your personal score and your country's ranking. At the end of each season, the nation with the most points is crowned champion, and a percentage of the prize goes to charitable causes chosen by the players themselves. Top participants from the winning country receive WMT rewards through a tiered system that rewards effort and consistency.
f2_desc: In addition to the global season, optional tournaments offer independent prize pools. Sign up, compete, and prove your skills. Each tournament is a new opportunity to claim part of the prize and climb the world ranking.
f3_desc: Your success depends on your dedication: daily streaks, click multipliers, and exclusive cosmetics you unlock through activity. WMT rewards those who contribute the most, creating an economy where effort has real value.
f4_desc: 15% of each season's prize pool goes to NGOs selected by players through a transparent voting system. Playing doesn't just benefit you — it also changes the world.
f5_desc: With per-season halving, token burns on every purchase, and a bonding curve system that prevents excessive accumulation, WMT is designed to grow sustainably and protect the value of holders' effort.
tk1_desc: Rewards are cut in half each season, creating progressive scarcity and protecting long-term value.
tk2_desc: A percentage of each transaction is permanently burned, continuously reducing the circulating supply.
tk3_desc: A system that prevents excessive accumulation and guarantees organic, sustainable token growth.
tk4_desc: Launched on Raydium with guaranteed initial liquidity and fair distribution for the community.
team_subtitle: The ones who make it happen. Four misfits rewriting the rules, one click at a time.
team_marco_desc: Founder. The crazy architect behind the vision. Converts caffeine into roadmaps and chaos into protocol. Believes one click can rewrite the world.
team_gustavo_desc: Cofounder. Uncorrectable creative. The bridge between wild ideas and real-world rules. Speaks fluently while keeping the community emotion alive. Makes sure we play hard but fair.
